title: GatePrepareApproval
description: Response of POST /approvals/:id/nonce on the phone listener (#15 issueNonce, consumed by #32 prepareApproval), and of POST /approvals/:id/edit for the new intent. Each call issues a new nonce and invalidates the previous one. The response has no challenge: the device builds it from payloadHash, intentId and nonce as decided in #85 (vectors/approval-challenge-vectors.json), so a compromised core cannot hand the device a challenge for a different payload.

payload.description: The stored canonical payload as RFC 8785 JSON text. The card is rendered from it, and payloadHash is the SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes.

payloadHash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 the gate computed over the stored canonical payload. Only the length is checked here.

nonce.description: Single-use nonce: 32 random bytes as unpadded base64url. Only the length is checked here.

documentIds.description: The documents the intent was built from, as proposed. The gate holds ids only; the PWA reads their names from core.

rationale.description: The agent's note on why it proposed the intent. Display-only: it is not part of the payload or its hash. Absent when the proposal had none.
